segments.text: - Proven cybersecurity and networking technical background with hands-on experience in network fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, and firewalls
- Experience with hands-on automation framework development: TestNG/Cypress/Selenium/Rest Assured/Cucumber/Jest etc.

- Knowledge and understanding of the OSI Network Reference Model, Layer 2 and Layer 3 Switching, Spanning Tree Protocols (STP, RSTP, MSTP), TCP/IP, and Routing Protocols (RIP and OSPF) is required. Knowledge of wireless and cellular technology and applications is a plus.
- Hands-on experience with Core Java and J2EE technologies (Java, Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate/MyBatis).
- Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
- Kotlin Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit
- Experience deploying applications to Kubernetes platforms such as Rancher, Amazon EKS, OpenShift, or other CNCF-compliant Kubernetes distributions.
- Knowledge of performance and load testing tools (k6, JMeter, Gatling)
- Well-versed in OAuth2 authentication, Open API/Swagger documentation, and API testing workflows using Postman.
- Daily hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar platforms.
- Solid working knowledge of network protocols such as BGP, VXLAN/EVPN, and DNS.

Configuring & validating the Comparator, Match tokens, Match & Merge setup and survivorship rules in MDM; Using ETL tools; Cloud-based infrastructure concepts; Programming/analysis/design with Java, Python, or SQL; Data modeling; and SQS or other messaging systems such as JMS.
- Strong knowledge of Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow and proficiency in Linux, SQL, Git and Bash scripting

- Deep expertise in a general-purpose programming language (e.g., Go, Java, C/C++, Scala, Python) and mastery in applying first principles thinking—actively questioning assumptions to create new knowledge and solutions for core engineering problems.
- Use technologies and tools such as: Go, Consul, Kafka, SQL, Chef, Git, Jira, gRPC, Prometheus, Grafana, Lightstep, Docker, DNS, and Kubernetes
- Strong proficiency in at least one backend language such as Python, Go, Java or Kotlin. Python is preferred.
- AWS, Azure, or GCP Cloud Architecture certifications
- Professional experience working in C++ and familiarity with RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, ThreadX) and bare-metal programming.
- Perform integration testing across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), IAM platforms (Okta, Ping Identity, Active Directory), and CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps)
- Familiarity with the following elements of a modern technology stack: Python, PostgreSQL, API tools such as Insomnia and Postman
- Experience with Containerized applications / Docker / Kubernetes
